messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Hello? Hello madam main ApnaBank fraud department se bol raha hoon.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Madam aap ke account se pachaas hazaar rupay nikalne ki koshish hui hai online.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Nahi nahi main ne kuch nahi bheja!

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Ji bilkul isi liye main ne call kiya hai. Rokne ke liye hum ne aap ko ek code bheja hai SMS par.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Woh verification code mujhe read kar dein abhi, transaction foran cancel hoti hai.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Theek hai ek minute... code aa gaya 55210.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Perfect madam. Aur yeh baat kisi ko na batana, na family ko na bank branch ko, confidential case hai.
